objective: Bind PQ-01A operator-pinned publisher attestation to the exact artifact bytes consumed by an explicit, opt-in pinned installation/upgrade effect. Preserve all preview paths as unqualified. Real attestation and independent trust custody remain external activation gates.
nonGoals: No release publication, issuance of signing credentials, trusted-root provisioning, or actual target deployment
No claiming that mocked subprocess verification establishes a genuine signed publisher
No unconditional qualification based on receipt strings, candidate-authored policies, or CI status
No change to protected workflow/ruleset or preexisting legacy installer semantics
decisions: Use an isolated, byte-copied, hash-verified artifact for the actual effect boundary instead of re-reading a mutable untrusted artifact path.
Keep the opt-in verified-apply API separate from the legacy development preview; no backwards-incompatible command behavior.
Treat independent policy custody, persistent anti-rollback, genuine live attestation and per-platform verifier support as incomplete and blocked claims.

obligations.description: Reject substituted artifact between publisher verification and installation, passing only a private byte-matched copy to pinned apply.
Reject incorrect mode, missing inputs, untrusted verifier result and mismatched hash before effect; leave errors observable.
Keep release and production authorization flags false, mark external publisher custody and live proof unavailable.

structure: src/sf/publisher_effect.py: authenticated pre-effect bridge to existing pinned installer
tests/test_publisher_effect.py: mocked observation verifies exact-copy admission and negative cases
docs/factory/evidence/PQ-01B.md: capture tested scope and external blockers
impact: New opt-in Python verified-apply entrypoint; existing commands and fixtures unaffected
No automatic authorization from successful proof; live qualification still pending

budget.network: GitHub repository writes only; no remote publisher request or deploy
budget.execution: Avoid creating PR or launching CI before stable head; run mandatory host checks once upon candidate PR open

externalEffects: Only branch and PR preparation in spsoftwarefc/s-f; no merge before PR 38 checkpoint
No target deployments, publishing or changes to adopter repositories
